Apache/2.2.26 (Unix) DAV/2 PHP/5.5.8 mod_ssl/2.2.26 OpenSSL/0.9.8y
with xdebug

![bildschirmfoto 2014-03-24 um 12 08 28](https://f.cloud.github.com/assets/3147888/2498311/b180ce5e-b344-11e3-914c-8b512b882013.png)
## Caching
### Reproduce
1. Get fresh advanced template
2. init Development env
3. create db and migrate the user schema
4. rename user table to t_user
5. create tables for RBAC
6. set up the app as follows
   common/main-local:

``` php
return [
    'components' => [
        'db' => [
            'class' => 'yii\db\Connection',
            'dsn' => 'mysql:host=localhost;dbname=db-name',
            'username' => 'root',
            'password' => 'yourpw',
            'charset' => 'utf8',
            'tablePrefix'=>'t_',
            'enableSchemaCache'=>true,
            'schemaCacheDuration'=>'300',
        ],
    ],
];
```

common/main:

``` php
return [
    'vendorPath' => dirname(dirname(__DIR__)) . '/vendor',
    'extensions' => require(__DIR__ . '/../../vendor/yiisoft/extensions.php'),
    'language' => 'de_DE',
    'components' => [
        'cache' => [
            'class' => 'yii\caching\DbCache',
            'cacheTable'=>'t_cache',
        ],
        'mail' => [
            'class' => 'yii\swiftmailer\Mailer',
            'viewPath' => '@common/mail',
            'useFileTransport' => true,
        ],
        'authManager' => [
            'class' => 'yii\rbac\DbManager',
            'defaultRoles' => ['Gast'],
        ],
    ],
];
```
1. try to register or login. it ends up in never ending recursing.

body:
The problem is that core components are only merged with app config and not registered beforehand: https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/blob/master/framework/base/Application.php#L211
This causes problems or endless loops when an error occurs while configuring components for example 'class' is not given in app component config.
ServiceLocator will throw exception which will try to get a logger component when handled which is not configured yet which results in a new exception.
Perhaps we should separate `Logger` from `LogRouter`, like we do in 1.1. `Logger` will be instantiated by `Yii`, not depending on `Application`.

I received this after trying to run `yii migrate/create`:
`exception 'yii\base\InvalidConfigException' with message 'Unknown component ID: errorHandler' in /opt/local/www/vendor/yiisoft/yii2/di/ServiceLocator.php:132`

body:
I had the same issue. I've added `class` to `assetManager` config and all works. Maybe it's not good fix, but for now it's work.

``` php
'assetManager' => [
    'class' => 'yii\web\AssetManager',
    'linkAssets' => true,
],
```
@joni-jones I too did it. But it just fixes error that produced ErrorException, and error above is from catching this exception. ErrorHandler – is cause of all problems.
Should be fixed. Please help test it. Thanks.
